name: dog
scene_note: a working copy. The master is ~/Desktop/LuckyDog-Harmony/_masters/LD_DOG_MA (read-only, extracted from LD_DOG_MA.7z in iCloud).

layers.note: head is the head minus every mouth-family element. mouth (34, Mouth_NEW) and mouth_family (Mouth_POCKET 30, Teeth 31, Tongue 32, Tongue_OUT 33, tongue_NEW 35, Tongue_flapper 38) are composited on separately. An earlier version left the six mouth_family ids in head while claiming to exclude only Mouth_NEW, so the head plate carried a mouth the compositor then drew a second mouth over. Dog_Drawover (20), LD_dg_turn (2), sketch_roughs (5) and Pivot_Guide (6) are reference layers and belong in neither.
layers.hands_note: Hand_01 (28) is a single element the rig draws twice through different pegs, so a gesture changes both of the dog's hands together. Its body list has one arm and one leg for the same reason.

face.note: measured from the three head-on drawings (16, 1, 11) in the full-face render. Their bottoms barely move (1671-1692) while their tops move 85px, so this mouth opens upward from a fixed lower lip and must be bottom-anchored. An earlier version read the geometry off drawing 12 by mistake - the render frame index is a position in the sorted drawing map, not the drawing number.

eye_note: white eyeballs with black pupils, unlike the doctor's flat discs. Found as enclosed white regions - white connected to the border is background.

mouth_source.command: uv run rig.py mouths <rig> --element 34 --out /tmp/dogall --map D1=1,...,D20=20  then  uv run face.py derive /tmp/dogall --out assets/rigs/dog/mouths --spec ...
mouth_source.note: Of the dog's 20 drawings only 16, 1 and 11 are drawn head-on (symmetry 0.96-0.97). The rest lean, and cutting between leaning mouths makes it appear to swing side to side. Scaling a symmetric mouth keeps it symmetric, so the vowel set is derived from those three: OO is drawing 1 at 55% width (a pucker), EE the same drawing stretched wide and flat.

capability_note: Only 3 of the 20 drawings are head-on; the vowel set is derived from those by non-uniform scaling. The lips do not change shape, only the proportions of the opening - it moves convincingly but does not form words. Real drawn vowels would still be better. tears is false because the cheek routing has not been measured for this face.

poses.note: View angles baked from the turnaround as head/body plate pairs, with the mouth and eye geometry measured per pose by difference against the head plate. A pose marked lipsync:false has its mouth too foreshortened to animate - the rigs have no profile mouth.

puppet.generated_by: puppet.py build - measured from plates/, do not edit by hand
